name: Hattori Kikuko
source:
The president of the student council, and an old aquaintance of Kazuki.
Kazuki meets her again, by coincidence, wishing that he didn't met her again.
She held a lot of secret, and is quite knowledgeable in the ninja world.
She is now a full time Otaku, skipping her responsability as a president
